svg.title: The morning after: Democrats take the House and Senate
svg.desc: Editorial illustration. At dawn, the white marble east front of the US Capitol, with its dome, central portico and House and Senate wings, glows apricot in low sun while a towering stylized blue wave swells behind it and curls over the dome. In the foreground a small TV crew films a reporter and passers-by walk toward the steps, casting long shadows. Represents Democrats winning control of both chambers of Congress in the 2026 midterms, reported Nov. 4, 2026; the wave is a symbol, not a real event.
